title: Conditional Phase Sensitivity and Atom–RestCorrelations in a Diamond Four-LevelOptomechanical Cavity
title_zh: 金刚石四能级光机械腔中的条件相敏性和原子静止相关性
summary: 我们研究了当原子与量子化腔场和机械模式相互作用时，最初存储在金刚石四能级原子中的相位信息如何重新分布。相位 φ 以原子叠加 (|1rangle+eⁱφ|2rangle)/sqrt2 编码，而光学和机械子系统以 Fock 状态启动。动力学是由粗粒度光机械哈密顿量与归一化非厄米无跳演化一起生成的。分析的中心点是诱导 |2rangle↔|3rangle 通道包含不同的光子算子 adagger ka^k 和 a^kadagger k；如果不改变动态，它们就无法合并。
abstract: We investigate how phase information initially stored in a diamond four-level atom is redistributed when the atom interacts with a quantized cavity field and a mechanical mode. The phase φ is encoded in the atomic superposition (|1rangle+eⁱφ|2rangle)/sqrt2, while the optical and mechanical subsystems start in Fock states. The dynamics are generated by a coarse-grained optomechanical Hamiltonian together with normalized non-Hermitian no-jump evolution. A central point of the analysis is that the induced |2rangle↔|3rangle channel contains the distinct photon operators adagger ka^k and a^kadagger k; they cannot be merged without changing the dynamics. The numerical study is deliberately restricted to the stationary, single-photon case k=1, for which the calculation is reproducible and the Hilbert-space truncation can be checked directly. We track the reduced-atomic quantum Fisher information (QFI), von Neumann entropy, purity, and total l₁ coherence. In the parameter range considered, increasing the optomechanical coupling G reduces the maximum conditioned atom--rest entropy from about 1.676 to 0.374 bits and raises the minimum atomic purity from about 0.356 to 0.876. At the same time, the time-averaged local QFI decreases from about 0.450 to 0.336, while the mean total coherence changes only weakly and non-monotonically. Thus stronger optomechanical coupling does not improve all quantum resources simultaneously: it keeps the conditioned atomic state purer and less entangled with the rest, but it also reduces the amount of phase information locally accessible from the atom. To expose this contrast more clearly, the time-dependent observables are plotted for two complementary combinations of G values, and the full nine-point coupling scan is summarized separately.

title: Topological Josephson trijunctions as a Majorana source and path
title_zh: 作为马约拉纳源和路径的拓扑约瑟夫森三结点
summary: 操纵马约拉纳束缚态是拓扑量子计算的关键要求。在这里，作者提出了一种磁场中的拓扑绝缘体约瑟夫森三结，它能够通过超导相的静态控制来生成、传输和融合马约拉纳束缚态。
abstract: Nature Communications, Published online: 07 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-79077-5 Manipulating Majorana bound states is a key requirement for topological quantum computation. Here, the authors propose a topological insulator Josephson trijunction in a magnetic field that enables the generation, transport, and fusion of Majorana bound states through static control of superconducting phases.

title: A fly-inspired directional microphone with integrated-photonic microring resonator transduction
title_zh: 具有集成光子微环谐振器传导功能的受苍蝇启发的定向麦克风
summary: 光子集成电路具有紧凑性、晶圆级可制造性和快速成熟的制造基础。据我们所知，在这里我们报告了第一个通过集成光子学转换的受苍蝇启发的定向麦克风：两个氮化硅微环谐振器位于摇摆隔膜的相对翼上，整体释放在背面博世蚀刻的腔体上方。离轴声音驱动反对称摇摆模式，使一个环处于拉伸状态，另一个环处于压缩状态；当激光偏置在每个环的共振斜率上时，相反的共振位移变成两个相反相位的强度信号，其差异可以转换方向运动。封装器件在 1553 nm 附近的加载光学品质因数为 18,635 和 17,974；
abstract: Photonic integrated circuits offer compactness, wafer-scale manufacturability and a fast-maturing fabrication base. Here we report what is, to our knowledge, the first fly-inspired directional microphone transduced by integrated photonics: two silicon-nitride microring resonators on opposite wings of a rocking diaphragm, monolithically released above a backside Bosch-etched cavity. Off-axis sound drives the antisymmetric rocking mode, straining one ring in tension and the other in compression; with the laser biased on each ring’s resonance slope, the opposite resonance shifts become two intensity signals of opposite phase, whose difference transduces the direction-bearing motion. The packaged device shows loaded optical quality factors of 18,635 and 17,974 near 1553 nm; scanning laser-Doppler vibrometry resolves the rocking mode near 15.8 kHz and the bending mode near 20.8 kHz. Tone-burst excitation at the two modal resonances demonstrates directional transduction directly in the time domain: at 90° incidence the two ring outputs oscillate in antiphase and their difference is enhanced, whereas at 180° they are in phase and the difference is suppressed. The optical response appears only after the acoustic time-of-flight and rings down after the drive ends, excluding electromagnetic pickup. Finite-element projections of an audio-band device, using shot-noise scaling, indicate an A-weighted signal-to-noise ratio of 74.6 dB(A), more than 10 dB beyond an optimized piezoelectric implementation of the same mechanics. These results constitute a proof-of-concept demonstration of a new transduction platform for chip-scale directional acoustic sensing, with a quantitative roadmap — higher optical quality factor, power— toward practical performance improvement.

title: Spin-induced polarization enables anodic carbon–nitrogen coupling electrocatalysis for sustainable formamide synthesis
title_zh: 自旋诱导极化能够实现阳极碳氮耦合电催化，用于可持续的甲酰胺合成
summary: 由可再生电力驱动并在水中反应的有机电合成提供了一条通过构建碳氮（C-N）偶联反应制备高附加值甲酰胺的绿色路线。目前，电化学甲酰胺合成主要集中在阴极过程，所需底物相对昂贵，电力和设备成本较高，极大地阻碍了工业实际应用。在此，我们报道了通过自旋诱导极化策略从混合多元醇和氨阳极电合成甲酰胺。我们提出，将 Fe 位点合金化到介孔 CuO 中，打破了其长程反铁磁有序，并产生了具有局部顺磁中心的自旋极化表面。
abstract: Organic electrosynthesis driven by the renewable electricity and reacted in water offers a green route to prepare higher value-added formamide by constructing carbon–nitrogen (C–N) coupling reactions. Currently, electrochemical formamide synthesis focuses mainly on cathodic processes, required relatively expensive substrates and high electricity and equipment costs, which greatly hinders practical application in industry. Herein, we reported anodic electrosynthesis of formamide from mixed polyols and ammonia by a spin-induced polarization strategy. We proposed that alloying Fe sites into mesoporous CuO broke its long-range antiferromagnetic order and created spin-polarized surface with localized paramagnetic centers. Spin-induced polarization strategy promoted the formation and stabilization of *NH2 intermediates without overoxidation to unreacted NO3−, which behaved as the dominant nucleophile to mediate concerted C–C cleavage and C–N coupling reactions for selective formamide synthesis with minor byproducts at anode. In a flow cell, it delivered a superior formamide Faradaic efficiency of 70.4% and selectivity of 99.0%, with the high net profit of US1,598 per ton. Meanwhile, the strategy has generally been applied to mixed polyols substrates mimicking the real feedstock from renewable biomass, which further underscored promising industrial application potential. This work establishes a new paradigm to construct efficient C–N coupling reactions for various value-added amides by a spin-state engineering strategy.
